opening.argument: The presentation is structured as conditional market analysis rather than a guaranteed-return proposition. It identifies the subject as “professional Elliott Wave and technical analysis of Chainlink (LINK), focusing on market structure, major support and resistance zones,” while the speaker presents a scenario in which the B wave may end within a resistance range before “we could see one more low.” The interpretation remains explicitly contingent: “Structure would change if we break above $9.74 in a decisive manner.” The chart’s labeled waves and marked support and resistance zones reinforce that analytical purpose. Affiliate links and informational disclaimers provide commercial context, but the stated evidence does not establish a deceptive transaction mechanism.
